issues.description: Attribute type mismatch for the Bitmap24::data member: the template repository's header declares 'int *data;' while the implementation (.cpp) treats it as a byte buffer (allocates with new char[...] and uses byte-indexing). The solution repository uses 'char *data;'. This inconsistency in the template will cause type errors and/or incorrect behavior and will likely prevent successful compilation or confuse students about the intended data representation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24::data member's type consistent with its usage by changing the declaration in template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'int *data;' to 'char *data;' (matching the implementation and the solution). Alternatively, modify the implementation to use an int-based buffer consistently, but preferrably use 'char *data' since the code writes byte RGB values.

issues.description: The Bitmap24 class member that holds the raw pixel buffer is declared with different types across artifacts: in the template repository header it is declared as 'int *data' whereas the implementation in the same template and the solution repository use 'char *data' and allocate/operate on it as a byte buffer. This mismatch (same conceptual attribute 'data' referenced with conflicting type identifiers) creates confusion for students and may cause compile errors or misinterpretation of the intended buffer representation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the Bitmap24 class member type across artifacts by declaring the buffer as 'char *data' in the template header (template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp). Update the comment if necessary to indicate a byte (char) buffer so that the header, implementation, and solution consistently refer to the same conceptual entity.
